name: Mui Ne resort living
summary: The 2018 plan makes the Mui Ne–Ham Tien sea zone the resort coast, about 340 ha of medium and small resorts on the sand.
body: Sleep on the Ham Tien sand, the built beach English Wikipedia calls Rang and foreigners call Mui Ne Beach. It sits west of the fishing ward. Decision 1772 puts the night in this sea zone.

Nguyễn Đình Chiểu (ĐT 706) and Võ Nguyên Giáp (ĐT 706B) tie the strip to Phan Thiet. Smaller rooms are named for the ward centers and the fishing village. A day pass and a kite lesson are Check on arrival.

properties.name: Pandanus Resort
properties.summary: Cham-style beachfront on Nguyen Huu Tho at the resort end of the strip.

properties.name: Asteria Mui Ne Resort
properties.summary: Large beachfront pool and arena stage on Xuan Thuy facing the East Sea.
